infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: iReader requires camera access to scan device IMEIs and barcodes for POS checkout.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: iReader POS requires Bluetooth access to discover, connect, and process card payments with physical Stripe card readers.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: iReader POS requires Bluetooth peripheral access for communicating with Stripe card readers.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: iReader POS requires location access to verify physical card reader location for fraud prevention and Stripe compliance.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: iReader POS requires local network access to discover and communicate with smart Stripe Readers (such as S700) on your local Wi-Fi.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: iReader POS requiere tu ubicación para aceptar pagos con Stripe Terminal.
plugins.bluetoothPeripheralPermission: iReader POS requiere Bluetooth para comunicarse con lectores Stripe.
plugins.bluetoothAlwaysUsagePermission: iReader POS usa Bluetooth para lectores Stripe compatibles.
plugins.localNetworkUsagePermission: iReader POS usa la red local para lectores Stripe compatibles.
